model_annotation: The provided image does not contain Figure 3(a); it contains Figure 4, which is a heatmap illustrating the experimental results of the TextCNN-CB model on the CCKS-IMLTC dataset under different combinations of positive and negative threshold values within the PST framework. The x-axis represents the positive threshold (P_pos), ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with uniform intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents the negative threshold (N_neg), ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with uniform intervals of 0.1. The heatmap uses a color scale where darker blue indicates higher F1 scores (up to 76) and lighter yellow indicates lower F1 scores (down to 72). The values within each cell represent the F1 score for that specific threshold combination. The text below the figure states that the optimal performance was achieved when the positive threshold was set to 0.6 and the negative threshold was set to 0.4.
